OP-FLASH is an attended, bounded observation — the person watched three full cycles and saw rapid alternation, but has no flash-frequency analyzer reading to decide whether the threshold is crossed. That is BLOCKED, not UNTESTED: someone looked, and the record says exactly what is missing.

OP-AD is a played-and-heard Shape 2 record, not a menu-only observation: specific positions were played with and without the description track, and what was heard (or not heard) over the silent stretch is reported directly. A single human FAIL is enough here; it does not need a second confirmation the way a PASS would.
